title: SimplePlaytime
description: A very simple mod / plugin project that adds support for playtime with commands and placeholder support for various platforms and plugins / mods.
body:
# SimplePlaytime
A simple mod / plugin that adds a playtime command that lets you see your playtime on the server using the servers own playtime stored value and adds support for multiple different mods and plugins that allow for placeholders so the values can be used wherever you want.


## Development Progress
Right now SimplePlaytime is only available for 1.21.1 NeoForge as this is what im running this for, though I am actively working on making it more common based so that for the first major release the project will support fabric, forge, neoforge and paper for version 1.21.1.


## Supported Mods
### [TAB by _NEZNAMY_](https://modrinth.com/plugin/tab-was-taken)
- %simpleplaytime_ticks%
- %simpleplaytime_seconds%
- %simpleplaytime_minutes%
- %simpleplaytime_hours%

## Supported Plugins
None

## Work in Progress Support
[ForgePlaceholderAPI by EnvyWare](https://github.com/EnvyWare/ForgePlaceholderAPI)
